conditions.quote_anchor: Is the 4 hour wicking? Has the 4 hour swept something?

conditions.quote_anchor: M1 is pretty easy to trade if you understand where price is going, but you need that higher time frame overhead to be able to operate on M1 a little better

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote grounds the higher timeframe supplying directional context for M1, but says nothing about identifying structural shifts.

conditions.quote_anchor: This is price breaking the range and trading back in.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote describes one instance of price breaking the range and trading back in, but is descriptive narration and never specifies the swing-high/low definition or a wait-for imperative.

conditions.quote_anchor: I always talk about the pullback being where your profit is.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote endorses the pullback as where profit is, but does not tie it to the previous range or to a reversal entry zone.

conditions.quote_anchor: when it gets back in there, I can use one of two things. I can place my entry at the 50

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote does place an entry on the return into the zone, but names the 50 level rather than a retest of the range high or low.

conditions.quote_anchor: a quality POI is more of a previous range that is the only thing that I use

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote establishes the previous range as the only POI he uses but never says a retest confirms its structural validity.

conditions.quote_anchor: it runs that wick and then you see an immediate push trading back into the range and now above that range. So that pool of liquidity that's there. Sorry, that's what I want people to focus on the most. That is the highest in probability to be able to trade a continuation

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote's highest-probability claim is about a wick run then reclaim above the range for a continuation, not about executing on a pullback into the previous range.

conditions.quote_anchor: market structure is the crux of what I trade I don't believe that you should do anything outside of market structure

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states outright that nothing should be done outside market structure, which is the alignment requirement the condition expresses.

conditions.quote_anchor: your stop or your invalidation of the idea is behind the 4hour POI

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote places the stop/invalidation behind the 4H POI, which is the condition's stop-placement rule in the trader's own words.

conditions.quote_anchor: when it comes to targeting, I tell people to target if there's a prominent wick to the left

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote is about targeting a prominent wick to the left, not previous daily highs or lows, so only the general structural-target idea carries over.
